title: Apple reports Q4 revenue from Services, which includes the App Store, Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud, and more, grew 10% YoY to $31.57B, vs. $31.58B est. (Loree Seitz/The Wrap)
summary: Loree Seitz / The Wrap: Apple reports Q4 revenue from Services, which includes the App Store, Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud, and more, grew 10% YoY to $31.57B, vs. $31.58B est. — The tech conglomerate beat Wall Street expectations with revenue hitting $114.48 billion — Getting your Trinity Audio player ready...
